description: The bar chart illustrates the CoLeG-R (%) performance of two models, LLaMA-2-13B and LLaMA-2-70B, under four different conditions: no SFT, SFT on $D_0$, SFT on $D_0, D_1$, and SFT on $D_0, D_1, D_2$. The vertical axis represents the CoLeG-R (%) score, ranging from 0 to 80, while the horizontal axis displays the two model variants. For both models, the performance generally increases with the addition of SFT data. In the LLaMA-2-13B model, the CoLeG-R score starts at approximately 67% with no SFT, increases to about 67% with SFT on $D_0$, rises to around 81% with SFT on $D_0, D_1$, and reaches its peak at approximately 85% with SFT on $D_0, D_1, D_2$. For the LLaMA-2-70B model, the scores are higher across all conditions: starting at about 70% with no SFT, increasing to roughly 74% with SFT on $D_0$, then to about 81% with SFT on $D_0, D_1$, and finally reaching approximately 84% with SFT on $D_0, D_1, D_2$. The chart shows that the LLaMA-2-70B model consistently outperforms the LLaMA-2-13B model in all four conditions, and that the performance of both models improves as more SFT data is added.
